name: SpanishModelVariant405_HandleRequest
evidence: matching spanish_model_variant/variant405_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it initialises the 0x326C-byte work area, selects the 32-byte record at descriptor + 0x38 indexed by the request and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame, calling the outer bands, shards and pulses helpers, and drives the fade and return codes through phases 2 to 6; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md; notes/overlays/spanish-model-variant405-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-388 images build the Spanish header-405 source with the palette column 512 instead of 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
